title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Rockstar Games build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition. Steam’s structured release date reflects the Complete Edition storefront listing (2020), not the 2008 original retail launch.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Rockstar / Take-Two services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency and launcher requirements. Older online components face elevated service risk. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam Complete Edition listing dated March 24, 2020. Grand Theft Auto IV originally launched in 2008; this accession records the licensed Complete Edition digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
